name: pangalin-space-manager
title: Pangalin Space Manager
description: See free space on your Mac and open the right page in Pangalin Space Manager. Every command except Free Space needs Pangalin Space Manager 3.62.0 or later.
author: pangalin

commands.name: free-space
commands.title: Free Space
commands.subtitle: Space Manager
commands.description: Show how much space is free on your startup disk.

commands.name: whats-taking-up-space
commands.title: What's Taking up Space
commands.subtitle: Space Manager
commands.description: Open the Space Manager dashboard to see what uses your disk.

commands.name: scan-my-mac
commands.title: Scan My Mac
commands.subtitle: Space Manager
commands.description: Start a new scan in Space Manager.

commands.name: review-safe-items
commands.title: Review Safe Items
commands.subtitle: Space Manager
commands.description: Open Space Manager's review with the safe items ticked. Nothing is removed from Raycast; you check and confirm in the app.

commands.name: find-files
commands.title: Find Files
commands.subtitle: Space Manager
commands.description: Search your files in Space Manager, for example "PDFs from last week".

commands.name: open-page
commands.title: Open Page
commands.subtitle: Space Manager
commands.description: Pick a Space Manager page and open it.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
